'''Nivel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Tarasin]], who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Nivel founded the business [[S&N Music]] with fellow Tarasin [[Slice (Tarasin)|Slice]], and they established a music distribution center in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Hedrett]] on Cularin. They began selling recordings of Tarasin music to tourists, and business soon took off, because the recordings gained popularity among members of aquatic [[Species/Legends|species]]. However, in c. [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system's]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]], [[Lavina Durada-Vashne Wren|Lavina Wren]] announced that she was getting engaged, and the S&N Music distribution center was subsequently graffitied with a statement that was hostile to the wedding. The graffiti angered Nivel and Slice, and they began cleaning it off.
